doc.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Day two: honors and later recordings
title: Swamp Sally with Mino Cinelu
summary: A duo record with electronics, where he played acoustic and keyboard bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Yeah, actually. There’s a record, for instance, a duo record I did with Mino Cinelu, called Swamp Sally. That was unusual, because it was the first time I had ever done a recording using a lot of electronics. I even played acoustic bass.
Ooo – going back to your roots.
You didn’t pull out the sousaphone, though.

No, no. I wasn’t going to do that. But I played – also played keyboard bass. We did a lot of pre-production work in Mino’s living room. I never worked that way before. It was interesting, and it was enjoyable.
